name: 金庸群侠传 (原名"侠客行三")
english_name: Heroes of Jin Yong (formerly Xia Ke Xing III)
english_description: Both the archive and its internal config call this game "Xia Ke Xing III," but the actual login banner reads "Heroes of Jin Yong" (Jin Yong Qun Xia Zhuan). It shares its core master codebase with this collection's jqxz2008 series — a different-era reskin and content version of the same engine. Deeper functional testing later corrected an overly optimistic early assessment, uncovering and fixing several real bugs, including a broken food/water initialization check and a crash affecting all 18 bulletin boards in the game.
